raw.description:
A very special Jupiter Disco debut, with some familiar faces coming back around.

At some point in the last year, it’d be a shame if you haven’t come across the selections of Prezzo, Uma Bullock, or Michael Reed. They share the nite with a mutual affection for the unexpected, and a soft spot for the dancers that make a room feel a little more like home.

Opening things up are two of the scene’s favorite dancers, Cris and Maggie, aka N.B. Rhythm and Majii. Beyond being apart of the Jersey-based crew Los Wachos, the two bring a deep knowledge of the genre to their selections, tracing its history through the sounds that have kept it moving across generations.

Boatneck continues the proceedings with his traveling circus of oddities. From melancholic house to deep dub, expect a few unexpected turns, some serious low-end business, and records that might leave you wondering where on earth they came from (in a good way).

The Groove Trackers head honcho, who goes by Prezzo behind the decks, makes his Jupiter Disco debut. We’re expecting a proper dance-floor workout here, the sort of set that gets a room moving in unison and sends peak time straight to the moon!

And finally, bringing things home is UMA DJ, who’s been on an absolute tear as of late. As co-founder of DANCE DANCE and Foundation of Funk, she knows a thing or two about putting the right records in the right room.

Give yourself a little extra time on the dance floor. We have a feeling you’ll need it:)

Offer your ticket to another fan

We believe tickets belong in the hands of fans, and that they should only ever be sold for a fair price. That’s why we have the Waiting List: if you can’t make it to a sold-out event, you can add your ticket to the queue to be purchased by another fan. If the ticket is sold, you’ll get your money back – no drama, no rip-offs.

There are a few conditions, though. Not every show will have the Waiting List function switched on (that’s up to the event organisers, not DICE), and tickets can only be added to the Waiting List after a show sells out. On top of that – and this is important – you’ll only get your money back if another fan buys your ticket.

If a friend is keen to attend an event you can’t make, you can transfer your ticket to them quickly and securely within the app. Just make sure you have their number saved in your phone, and that they have a DICE account registered with that number.

SONIDO DE BOGOTÁ IS A DEDICATION TO THE CITY AND THE ELECTRONIC MUSIC CULTURE THAT CONTINUES TO SHAPE OUR IDENTITY. THIS SPECIAL EDITION BRINGS TO NEW YORK A SELECTION OF ARTISTS REPRESENTING DIFFERENT GENERATIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS OF BOGOTÁ’S TECHNO SOUND. A REFLECTION OF THE MUSIC, THE SPACES AND THE PEOPLE THAT HAVE MADE THE CITY AN ESSENTIAL PART OF OUR HISTORY.

BORN IN NEW YORK, ROOTED IN BOGOTÁ, CRUD0 WAS FOUNDED ON AN UNDERSTANDING OF TECHNO AS MORE THAN ENTERTAINMENT, A DISCIPLINE AND A COLLECTIVE EXPERIENCE CENTERED ON THE DANCE FLOOR. OVER DECADES, BOGOTÁ HAS DEVELOPED A DISTINCT MUSICAL LANGUAGE THROUGH EXPERIMENTATION, INDEPENDENCE AND A RESISTANCE TO COMMERCIAL CONVENTIONS. A SCENE BUILT ON ITS OWN TERMS, WITHOUT COMPROMISING ITS ORIGINAL VISION.

THIS PHILOSOPHY REMAINS CENTRAL TO CRUD0, INFORMING ITS CURATORIAL DIRECTION AND ITS COMMITMENT TO LONG HOURS, UNCOMPROMISING SOUND AND A PROTECTED DANCE FLOOR.

SELECTORS

PAULA VÉLEZ

A TRUE REPRESENTATIVE OF BOGOTÁ’S TECHNO SOUND, PAULA VÉLEZ HAS BEEN AN ACTIVE FORCE IN COLOMBIA’S ELECTRONIC MUSIC SCENE SINCE 2005. HER JOURNEY BEGAN WITH ACID COMMANDERS, A FOUR-TURNTABLE ACID TECHNO PROJECT THAT SHAPED HER DEEP CONNECTION TO VINYL AND THE RAW FOUNDATIONS OF THE GENRE.

IN 2008, SHE LAUNCHED HER SOLO PROJECT, CITRIK POLLY, EXPLORING NEW DIMENSIONS OF TECHNO WHILE ESTABLISHING BULLET, A FEMALE DJ COLLECTIVE AND EVENT PLATFORM. HER WORK EXTENDED INTO VENEZUELA AND LATER EUROPE, WHERE SHE BECAME INVOLVED WITH MADRID’S KILLSOUND COLLECTIVE AND MELTING POT RECORDS, PERFORMING ACROSS SPAIN AND BERLIN.

AFTER FOUR YEARS IN EUROPE, PAULA RETURNED TO COLOMBIA, PERFORMING AT BAUM, TATACOA FESTIVAL, BLACK BOX FESTIVAL AND RADIKAL STYLES, WHILE REMAINING CONNECTED TO KEY PLATFORMS SUCH AS THC, BOGOTRAX AND INDUSTRIAL GIRLS. HER INTERNATIONAL JOURNEY ALSO INCLUDES NEW YORK, BOSTON, ECUADOR AND COSTA RICA.

WITH TWO DECADES BEHIND THE DECKS, PAULA VÉLEZ REMAINS A DISTINCTIVE REPRESENTATIVE OF COLOMBIAN TECHNO AND ITS ROOTS.

VARJU

BORN IN BOGOTÁ, VARJU REPRESENTS THE CURRENT IDENTITY OF THE CITY’S TECHNO SOUND. INFLUENCED BY THE RAW ENERGY OF ROCK AND METAL, HIS MUSICAL APPROACH MOVES THROUGH HYPNOTIC, MENTAL, ATMOSPHERIC AND RAW TECHNO, BUILT ON DEEP GROOVES, SUBTLE MELODIC PROGRESSIONS AND PRECISE RHYTHMIC STRUCTURES. HIS DJ SETS GO BEYOND CONVENTIONAL MIXING, DEVELOPING CAREFULLY CONSTRUCTED NARRATIVES THROUGH TENSION, MOVEMENT AND SONIC EXPLORATION.

AS A PRODUCER, VARJU CONTINUES TO DEVELOP HIS OWN SONIC IDENTITY, EXPLORING THE BOUNDARIES BETWEEN TECHNO AND EXPERIMENTAL ELECTRONIC MUSIC. BEYOND THE BOOTH, HE PLAYS AN ACTIVE ROLE IN BOGOTÁ’S ELECTRONIC MUSIC CULTURE THROUGH HIS WORK WITH GRV.DVSN AND BAUM BOGOTÁ.

HIS JOURNEY HAS LED HIM TO SHARE THE STAGE WITH ARTISTS SUCH AS OSCAR MULERO, ADRIANA LOPEZ, THE ADVENT, CLAUDIO PRC, TOMMY FOUR SEVEN, PETER VAN HOESEN, RENE WISE, TEMUDO AND QUELZA, ESTABLISHING HIM AS PART OF A GENERATION SHAPING THE PRESENT AND FUTURE OF COLOMBIAN TECHNO.

GIOVANI

EMERGING FROM BOGOTÁ’S FORMATIVE YEARS OF ELECTRONIC MUSIC, GIOVANI BELONGS TO A GENERATION OF ARTISTS WHO HELPED ESTABLISH THE FOUNDATIONS OF THE CITY’S TECHNO CULTURE. ACTIVE SINCE 2000, HIS EARLY YEARS WERE SHAPED BY A GROWING NETWORK OF INDEPENDENT CLUBS AND DANCE FLOORS. IN 2003, VICTORIES AT THE HUMAN PATTERN AND THE RIDDLE DJ CONTESTS LED TO HIS FIRST RESIDENCY AT SUBROYAL, A KEY CHAPTER IN HIS DEVELOPMENT BEHIND THE DECKS.

DRAWING FROM ELECTRO, TECHNO, HOUSE AND BREAKS, HIS SELECTIONS REFLECTED THE MUSICAL DIVERSITY OF BOGOTÁ’S EARLY ELECTRONIC MOVEMENT. THROUGH APPEARANCES AT MONITOR, BARBARELLA, ARENA, LA SALA AND 4ROOMS, GIOVANI BECAME PART OF A CLUB CULTURE THAT WOULD CONTINUE TO DEFINE THE CITY’S ELECTRONIC MUSIC IDENTITY.

WITH OVER TWO DECADES BEHIND THE DECKS, GIOVANI REMAINS A DIRECT CONNECTION BETWEEN BOGOTÁ’S TECHNO ROOTS AND NEW YORK’S DANCE FLOORS.

Locky found his love for dance music on London’s dance floors and through its nightlife. That early connection to the energy of the UK underground shaped a sound rooted in house and garage—grounded in tradition but always moving forward. Those who have had the chance to experience a Locky set can attest that the musical journey they undertake is a bit like an ode to London itself. This is down to the thousands of hours Locky has spent on dancefloors across the capital city, soaking up every element of iconic parties from Fuse to Appetite, which he translates across his production and sets.

Since 2019, Locky has evolved from a raver into a world-respected selector. He started off playing parties around his home city at venues like Fabric & 93 Feet East, honing his skills as a DJ. In 2022, Locky burst onto the Underground House scene with an impactful release on Beeyou. He followed with tasteful releases across multiple respected labels such as neXup, UVAR, and many more that garnered support from a long list of industry heavyweights that includes names like Chris Stussy, Rossi, and Enzo Siragusa. 2025 has seen Locky play around the world in countries such as Sri Lanka, Australia, and Spain, at top parties and venues such as The Warehouse Project, After Caposile, and Appetite, to name a few.

Looking forward, Locky has his sights on dominating the global house music market. With massive releases in the pipeline coming alongside his best friends, Max Dean, Luke Dean, and Mad. Again. You’ll find Locky playing the world’s biggest stages, such as Glastonbury, Shelter, and virtually every club in Ibiza, where he’ll be shaping the ears of modern-day ravers, whose shoes he was in not so long ago, one cathartic set at a time.
